import subprocess

# Test the observable behaviors for m2
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-c', '''
from boltons.iterutils import partition

# Test 1: Single predicate (existing behavior)
r1 = partition([1, 2, 3], lambda x: x > 1)
print(f"Test 1: {r1} == ([2, 3], [1]) -> {r1 == ([2, 3], [1])}")

# Test 2: Multiple predicates
r2 = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 1, lambda x: x < 3])
print(f"Test 2: {r2} == ([2], [1], [3]) -> {r2 == ([2], [1], [3])}")

# Test 3: Original behavior still works
nonempty, empty = partition(['', '', 'hi', '', 'bye'])
print(f"Test 3: nonempty={nonempty}, empty={empty}")

# Test 4: With string attribute key
class Obj:
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val = val
objs = [Obj(0), Obj(1), Obj(0)]
r4 = partition(objs, 'val')
print(f"Test 4: {r4}")

# Test 5: Overlapping predicates - element can only go to first matching bucket
r5 = partition([1, 2, 3, 4], [lambda x: x > 2, lambda x: x > 1])
print(f"Test 5 (overlapping): {r5}")
# 1: no match -> last bucket
# 2: matches pred2 (x>1) but not pred1 (x>2) -> second bucket
# 3: matches pred1 (x>2) -> first bucket
# 4: matches pred1 (x>2) -> first bucket
# Expected: ([3, 4], [2], [1])

# Test 6: Empty source with multiple predicates
r6 = partition([], [lambda x: True, lambda x: False])
print(f"Test 6 (empty): {r6}")

# Test 7: All elements in remaining bucket
r7 = partition([1, 2, 3], [lambda x: x > 10, lambda x: x > 20])
print(f"Test 7 (all remaining): {r7}")
'''], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[:500])
